meta.name: advise-project-approach
meta.description: Research and advise on the best way to approach a software project, including architecture, tech stack, implementation strategy, pricing/operating-cost tradeoffs, benchmark research, and comparisons with similar real-world projects. Use before building, mid-build, or after completion when the user asks for project strategy, optimal approach, research comparables, similar projects, stack selection, vendor/service choice, repo analysis, architecture critique, implementation feedback, or a prioritized improvement plan. Avoid for narrow single-bug debugging or isolated file edits unless the user asks for broader project direction.

copy.tagline: 研究并建议软件项目的最佳架构、技术栈和实施策略。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在规划或改进一个软件项目的整体方向。
